## Checklist

- [ ] I wrote this change myself and have read every line of it; it was not generated automatically from an issue.
- [ ] I ran the package's tests (`uv run poe test-<package>`) and they pass.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where behaviour or options change.
- [ ] The package's `docs/changelog.rst` has an entry under *Unreleased*.
- [ ] `uv run poe lint` and `uv run poe typecheck` pass.
